items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Matches the reference exactly: a one-line call with a clear comment, '# Ensure base table is in aliases.', formatted the same way as the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Minimal change that reuses the existing helper query.get_initial_alias(). No duplicated logic, no dead code, and Collector/QuerySet.delete are left untouched.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: One idempotent helper call that adds no error-handling risk and no magic constants. Hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: Fixes the root cause in SQLDeleteCompiler.single_alias by calling self.query.get_initial_alias() before counting aliases. Joined deletes still count more than one alias and keep the subquery, the MySQL override benefits from the same fix, and there is no backend-specific branch.
